entries.decision: Founded LaunchRoast: a $9 AI landing-page teardown service.
entries.why: 200+ builders at this hackathon are shipping landing pages today and need conversion feedback instantly. Instant digital fulfillment means revenue can start within the hour.
Below the impulse-purchase threshold for the target customer (founders/hackers), high enough to signal the output is a product, not a gimmick.

entries.decision: Wired human-in-the-loop QA through Terac: every delivered roast files a $1 human review task.
entries.why: An autonomous company still needs taste checks. Humans are hired per-task as contractors; none are employed.

entries.decision: Launch a 'Roast Leaderboard' flash campaign at the hackathon: every $9 teardown gets scored, top-3 bravest roasts get a free second roast after they ship fixes, with results posted live until 8:30 PM EDT.
entries.why: The crowd is here NOW and competitive; a public leaderboard turns private feedback into social proof and FOMO, driving impulse $9 buys before the deadline.

entries.decision: Launched a 15-person human panel study on Terac ($90 of hackathon credits): real people vote on which product voice ships — 'Brutal Roast' vs 'Straight-Talk Coach'.
entries.why: The product's voice is its differentiator. Rather than guess, the company pays 15 humans to decide; the winning style becomes the production prompt and the vote is published here.

entries.decision: First paid human verdict is in (Terac panelist, approved & paid): 'Straight-Talk Coach' leads on worth-$9 and shareability; 'Brutal Roast' leads on trust. Decision: keep the Brutal Roast backbone, adopt the Coach's depth — more concrete suggested fixes per problem, which was also the panelist's $19-upsell request.
entries.why: Real human input over guesswork: the vote is attributed to Terac submission hv6m8ljqwt50eughceqsobeq in our database. The study stays live for the remaining 14 panelists; the tally is public at /api/study-vote.
